title: Újpest's style of play in chance creation
subtitle: Újpest | Hungarian NB I 2026/2027

kpis.name: Shots from sustained attacks %
kpis.description: Percentage of shots by the team that come from possessions that do not start with a set-piece in the final third where the team has 8 or more passes in the attacking half per match.

kpis.name: Shots from direct attacks %
kpis.description: Percentage of shots by the team that come from possessions that do not start with a set-piece in the final third where at least 50% of the total ball movement is forward per match.

kpis.name: Shots per final-third pass
kpis.description: Number of shots by the team divided by their number of non-set-piece passes originating in the final third per match.

kpis.name: Shots from outside the box %
kpis.description: Percentage of shots by the team from outside of the box per match.
